theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U d) (V : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U d, X ω = Y ω + Z ω) → X.massOn V ≤ Y.massOn V + Z.massOn V
